name: adori-ai
description: Turn an idea, script, or article link into a narrated video.

interface.longDescription: Adori AI turns an idea, script, or article link into a narrated video. It writes scenes, generates or finds visuals, and gives you a link to watch the video once it is ready. Before making or exporting anything it tells you what it will cost and what your plan has left, and only goes ahead once you agree. You can check your plan and balance, follow progress, list projects, read scene narration, open preview links, and export a finished video to an MP4. Editing scenes happens in the Adori web app. An Adori account and sign-in are required.
capabilities: Create videos from ideas, scripts, or article links
Show the cost before making or exporting, and wait for your go-ahead
Check your plan and what it has left
List and read projects in your Adori account
defaultPrompt: Create a 30-second portrait video about five ways to stay focused at work.
What does my plan have left this month?
Export my newest video to an MP4.

positive.description: Report the plan and what it has left
positive.prompt: What plan am I on, and how many credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the account's plan and what it has left to spend (credits, or for older plans the videos and exports left this billing period), the video-length limit and the allowed visual types, without changing the account.

positive.description: Price a short video, then create it once the user agrees
positive.prompt: Create a 30-second portrait video about five practical ways to stay focused at work, using AI images.
positive.expected_behavior: Tell the user the estimated cost and what the account has left, and ask whether to go ahead. Only after the user agrees, start one matching project and report its progress. Give the watch link only once the video is ready.

positive.description: List projects and summarize the newest one
positive.prompt: List my five newest videos, then summarize the scenes and narration in the newest one.
positive.expected_behavior: List up to five projects from the connected account and summarize only the scenes and narration from its newest project.

positive.description: Return a watch link for an existing project
positive.prompt: Give me a link to watch my newest video.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the newest project in the connected account, return its preview link, and explain that anyone with the link can watch it.

positive.description: Price an export, then export once the user agrees
positive.prompt: Export my newest video to a 720p MP4.
positive.expected_behavior: Tell the user what exporting at 720p will cost and what the account has left, and ask whether to go ahead. Only after the user agrees, start the export, then return the MP4 link once it has finished.

negative.description: Refuse a video longer than the connected account allows without creating a project
negative.prompt: Create a 60-minute video about the history of cinema.

negative.description: Do not delete projects because the plugin has no deletion tool
negative.prompt: Delete all videos in my Adori account.

negative.description: Do not create a video or export when the user declines the quoted price
negative.prompt: Make a 2-minute video about volcanoes. (When told the cost, reply: no, cancel.)

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Shows the cost and asks for the user's go-ahead before making or exporting a video. Adds exporting to MP4 from chat, and answers questions about the plan and credits. The watch link now appears only once the video is ready.
